content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach detected for tenant 'neptune-financial' (dedicated pool: neptune-eu-west-3-dedicated-01). p99=2.80s (SLO=1.50s), p95=1.10s. Triggered by continuous 5m window. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/neptune/latency?pool=neptune-eu-west-3

alice.sre: I'm taking lead. Oncall @ben.infra — can you confirm pool health and whether warm spare is available? We may need immediate traffic shift + scale.

ben.infra: I'm on it. Pulling pool status now. Initial read: nodes 04/06 reporting elevated queue_time and reactor backlog. No spike in 5xx but tail latency is high.

ben.infra: Running quick commands to inspect and scale:
```
# inspect pool
rwictl pools describe neptune-eu-west-3-dedicated-01
# scale up replicas to absorb burst
rwictl pools scale --pool neptune-eu-west-3-dedicated-01 --replicas 6
```

emily.ops: Noted customer impact: Nept reported intermittent slow responses to API calls; no SLA-abort yet. CSM has been paged.

carla.am: I'm onstandby to notify Anita at Neptune. ETA messaging: "we're investigating elevated latency, mitigation in progress, will update in 15m".

dave.csm: Customer oncall (Anita) just asked if we have ETA. Keeping them updated.

ben.infra: Scale command accepted, starting additional instances. Also preparing to drain a few suspect nodes and shift tenant traffic off the hottest machines.

ben.infra: Draining & routing commands:
```
rwictl node drain --node neptune-eu-west-3-node-12 --grace-period 30s
rwictl routing shift --tenant neptune-financial --from pool=neptune-eu-west-3-dedicated-01 --to pool=neptune-eu-west-3-dedicated-02 --percent 50
```

alice.sre: Good. Greg, can you check KV cache hit-rate for the tenant prefix? If cache churn is causing regen overhead, that explains tail.

greg.runtime: KV cache hit-rate for prefix "neptune/" dropped from ~98% to ~64% over last 12m. Evidence of high prefix diversity and large contexts.

ben.infra: That matches what I'm seeing—lots of long-context requests causing backend pressure. Applying temporary tenant-level guardrails: limit very long sequences and enable burst shaping.

ben.infra: Applying policy: 
```
rwictl tenant update neptune-financial --policy '{"max_seq_len":1024,"burst_rate":50,"rate_limit_mode":"token_bucket"}'
```

emily.ops: Also enabling fallback model variant (quantized low-latency) for new sessions as a quick mitigation to reduce per-token cost and latency.

alice.sre: Can we enable sticky KV routing for existing cached sessions to avoid cache misses? If not available, prioritize reducing churn.

greg.runtime: Sticky routing toggle isn't fully rolled out in this cluster, but I can enable the quantized fallback and a routing policy that biases existing connections to their cache node. Enabling now.

incident-bot: ACTIONS APPLIED: scaled pool + drained hot node + routing shift + tenant rate-limit + quantized fallback. Observability link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/neptune/alerts/4612345679

ben.infra: Early signal: p99 dropped to ~1.60s within 4 minutes of mitigation. Continuing to observe.

alice.sre: Keep sampling for another 10m. If stable, we'll keep mitigations and plan postmortem. Ben/greg, please capture logs for which requests caused cache churn (examples + request fingerprints).

carla.am: Customer update sent: "Mitigations in progress; preliminary metrics show improvement. Will follow up in 15m with status." Anita acknowledged.

dave.csm: Logged customer impact: approx 12 minutes of p99 breach window, no 5xx, some timeouts for long contexts. Marking potential SLA impact; will submit claim flow if final breach confirmed.

ben.infra: p99 now stable ~1.40s and trending down. Removing emergency scale once stable for 8m.

alice.sre: Next steps: create incident ticket with owners (ben.infra, greg.runtime, product) for RCA. Immediate action items:
- Tune autoscale thresholds for dedicated pools with high-tail workloads
- Add throttle/tenant-isolation guardrails for long-context streams
- Fast-track sticky KV routing for eu-west clusters

carla.am: I'll coordinate post-incident comms and hold a follow-up call with Anita tomorrow.

greg.runtime: I'll collect cache metrics and sample request fingerprints and attach to ticket.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigations holding, p99 within SLO. Recommended postmortem and customer follow-up.

alice.sre: Thanks everyone. Closing warroom when no regressions for 30m. :white_check_mark:

carla.am: Thanks team — passing to postmortem now. :thumbsup:
